title: ER = EPR
description: Maldacena and Susskind's conjecture: two entangled particles are joined by a wormhole, too small to pass through. Entanglement is geometry. Unlocks the ER=EPR Weaver.

puzzle.goal: Each maximally entangled pair of qubits shares one unit of entanglement entropy. Write the entropy S of n such pairs, in nats.
puzzle.name: Bell-pair counting
puzzle.method: Each half of a Bell pair is in a mixed state, ½ and ½: its entropy is −Σ p ln p = ln 2.
